description: Explore SMK, the National Gallery of Denmark: search over 200,000 paintings, prints, drawings and sculptures by artist, type, technique, date and more, read an artwork's full record with its images and whether they are free to reuse, find artworks that look alike or show places near you, pick random highlights, and look up artists. A trigger starts a workflow when SMK adds a matching artwork. No account or API key required.

smk_new_artwork_trigger.description: Runs when SMK adds an artwork matching a search to its online collection, with its title, artist, date, image links and whether it is in the public domain. Checked every five minutes at most.
